name: Bee
overview: The Bible uses the imagery of bees to depict both danger and provision in the land of Palestine and beyond. In Deuteronomy and Psalms, bees symbolize aggressive enemies that swarm and attack like a relentless force, yet God empowers His people to overcome them. Judges presents bees as a source of unexpected sweetness and sustenance, found even in a lion's carcass, highlighting God's provision. Isaiah describes the Lord's sovereign control over even the smallest creatures, calling forth the bee by His hiss as a demonstration of His authority over nations.
